answer_span_consistency.note: passed: no text immediately precedes the response slot

target_fidelity.note: It is a positive present progressive active declarative with no modal.

naturalness.note: The prompt and requested copied sentence are coherent.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It only asks the learner to copy a displayed answer, so it does not meaningfully practise the target grammar.

determinacy.note: The prompt explicitly specifies the exact sentence to copy.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: All vocabulary is common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt displays the complete target answer verbatim.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: No unrelated advanced grammar is needed.
